facts.text: Reach the ridge from the Big Lake trailhead on the PCT: about five miles along, where the PCT bends south under the ridge, leave it and go cross-country to a low notch on the ridge.
The north-side ways into the lower notch have the worst rock; the south-side fourth-class slab is cleaner (July-August).
Pitch out only the low dihedral; the narrow middle crest simuls well with long slings over horns.
50 m rope and about a dozen slings, several double-length (July-August); cams to #3 and a few offset nuts
Come down the North Ridge: three rappels, and with a 50 m rope one short fourth-class downclimb remains after the second; avoid kicking scree onto parties below (July-August).

notes: No harvested track is logged as West Ridge or Southeast Spur with GPS points, so both tracks are null. All harvested tracks with points (3275972, 3393187, 2996938, 2020847, 182456) are North Ridge, which is or_north_ridge_2 (already has a track, not in this packet). Peakbagger summit 44.33215,-121.83853 agrees with all track highs (3-18 m).
